sources.title: Sometimes the form doesn't send information to the webhook
Adding Custom User ID to Webhook Payload (customParams)
Patch a record using the primary field | Airtable Community
How to search for specific value through API filterByFormula? | Airtable Community

notes: Webhook payload includes all form fields as JSON in request body.
Empty payloads may occur due to timeout, firewall, or large base64 draw fields; ensure endpoint responds within 30 seconds.
Hidden fields are included in payload and can be used for tracking (e.g., user ID).
customParams field is not populated and cannot be used for custom data mapping.
To ensure reliable delivery, use Jotform Workflows with Webhook element instead of direct integration if empty payloads persist.
filterByFormula uses Airtable formula syntax; email must be wrapped in single quotes and URL-encoded.
Returns array of matching records; assume email is unique so only one record returned.
If no records found, records array will be empty.
Field names with spaces must be wrapped in curly brackets in formula (e.g., {First Name}).
API key must be provided via Authorization: Bearer <key> header.
PATCH only updates fields included in the request body; omitted fields remain unchanged.
Requires record ID obtained from prior GET request using filterByFormula.
If all target fields are empty or not present in Jotform payload, connector may skip PATCH call.
Airtable does not enforce uniqueness on primary field; lookup must be done via filterByFormula on a unique field like email.
API key must be provided via Authorization: Bearer <key> header.
